## Selected Engineering Case Studies
- [Content-Refresh Scoring Pipeline (FlyRank)](https://abdul-samad-portfolio.example.com/work/content-refresh-pipeline): Predictive ML scoring pipeline ranking content pages by decline risk using DuckDB and Random Forest (0.74 precision@50, 3x gain over baseline).
- [AI Assistive Navigation System](https://abdul-samad-portfolio.example.com/work/assistive-navigation): Real-time assistive robotics system for visually impaired users using YOLOv8, DeepSORT, and 360-degree LiDAR-camera fusion on ROS2/Raspberry Pi 4 (<200ms latency, 70% collision risk cut).
- [Daftar](https://abdul-samad-portfolio.example.com/work/daftar): Multi-agent workplace simulation built at AICON'26 by team nexora with Gemini and Next.js, running hidden browser tests and evaluating 6 workplace skills.
- [Capital Play](https://abdul-samad-portfolio.example.com/work/capital-play): Full-stack sports venue booking platform featuring 3 role dashboards, automated background Ghost Engine for slot lifecycles, and real-time Socket.io concurrency.

## Selected Personal & Open-Source Projects
- [Daftar](https://trydaftar.vercel.app): Multi-agent workplace simulation where a fresh graduate works a first shift with AI personas.
- [Capital Play](https://capital--play.vercel.app): Sports ground booking platform with multi-role dashboards, automated slot engine, and live messaging.
- [RideFlow](https://ride--flow.vercel.app): Full-stack ride hailing platform with MySQL stored procedures, triggers, views, atomic wallet payments, and Google Maps tracking.
- [AI-ML-Automation-Tools](https://github.com/Abdul-Samad-17/AI-ML-Automation-Tools): Modular suite of 5 AI tools (FAQ chatbot, email classifier, document QA, RAG chatbot, and FastAPI workflow automation).
- [CineGraphX](https://github.com/Abdul-Samad-17/CineGraphX): Zero-STL C++ graph and tree database over 5,000 IMDb movies with custom AVL trees, achieving 5x faster search.
- [FlyRank-Internship](https://abdul-samad-17.github.io/FlyRank-Internship/): Content-refresh scoring pipeline repository and documentation.
- [GridLock Rush](https://github.com/Abdul-Samad-17/GridLock-Rush): Bare-metal 2D arcade traffic game written in pure x86 Assembly.
